Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries at all — it’s very simple to start with Nurosym 👍
Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear)
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, cable goes over and behind your ear
Turn it on and slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light tingling
Keep it at a comfortable level (not painful)
Use it for about 15–60 minutes per session, ideally daily
You can use it while doing normal things like reading, working, or relaxing. Many people use it in the morning or split it between morning and evening.
Tip: start with shorter sessions and lower intensity, then gradually build up. It should always feel pleasant, not uncomfortable.
If you want, I can walk you through a simple daily routine to make it even easier 👍
